desc: Ideation: binary search over L in [1,n] with an exact feasibility check.
Implement `Solution.minLength` (binary search + dp[last_bit][run_len] = min flips feasibility check).
Run all provided examples and the listed edge cases in a single script, print expected vs actual, and report an explicit PASS/FAIL for every case.
Output the finalized `Solution.minLength` (confirmed complexity O(n^2 log n), no greedy fallback).
Exhaustive brute-force cross-check over all binary strings length 1..6 with every numOps in 0..n (all PASS, confirming the extend-transition cost fix).
(fallback, dropped) O(n) greedy per-run counting — disproven by "0110",L=1 counterexample.
(fallback, dropped) Direct DP over positions without binary search — unnecessary; current split is sound.
